episodes.synopsis: Uozumi Rikuo runs into his old crush, Morinome Shinako, and Nonaka Haru runs into her old crush, Rikuo.
episodes.title: A Misfit's Attempt at Self-Reform

episodes.synopsis: Hayakawa Rou is a student at the school where Morinome Shinako teaches. They seem to have some kind of shared history.
episodes.title: Cul-de-sac

episodes.synopsis: Rikuo catches a cold after standing in the rain with Haru. She invites him to the movies as a way of apologizing.
episodes.title: What Is Love?

episodes.synopsis: Hayakawa Rou is in love with Morinome Shinako, who hasn’t moved on from the late Hayakawa Yuu, Rou’s brother. She visits their home back in Kanazawa.
episodes.title: As the River Flows, Shinako Returns Home

episodes.synopsis: Minato Kouichi was a classmate of Morinome Haru, and a student of photography. They run into each other at Rikuo’s workplace.
episodes.title: The Man Named Minato

episodes.synopsis: Rikuo's old flame from school finds him and soon becomes his uninvited roommate. Later, Shinako and Haru meet her and misunderstand the situation.
episodes.title: The Woman Named Yuzuhara

episodes.synopsis: Shinako and Rou get into a fight. Rikuo tries to help mend things, but the answers aren’t clear.
episodes.title: Premonition of a Couple

episodes.synopsis: Shinako invites Rikuo over, but she chickens out, making a fragile friendship even more tenuous.
episodes.title: Innocent Blue

episodes.synopsis: Rikuo’s friends want to invite him and Shinako over for Christmas. Rou has plans of his own.
episodes.title: Christmas Carol

episodes.synopsis: Shinako calls off going back to Kanazawa for the new year. She and Rikuo make plans to spend it together.
episodes.title: A New Year of Beginnings

episodes.synopsis: A burglar breaks into Haru’s place. Rikuo gives her company for the night after.
episodes.title: A Spring Storm

episodes.synopsis: Rikuo notices that something isn’t quite right between him and Shinako. Meanwhile, Haru suffers.
episodes.title: The Long Way
